name: finance-metrics
description: Descriptive analysis only — not financial advice, and this tool never places an order. Computes standard portfolio/return risk metrics (volatility, Sharpe, Sortino, max drawdown, total/annualised return) from prices or a returns series you provide, a Pearson correlation matrix across multiple return series, and per-strategy win-rate/expectancy/Kelly-fraction stats from a list of recorded trades. Use it to sanity-check numbers on data you already have, not to fetch market data or decide what to trade.

prices.description: A single price series. If 'returns' is omitted, returns are derived from consecutive prices.

returns.description: Per-period returns (e.g. 0.01 = 1%). Takes precedence over deriving returns from 'prices'.

returnsByAsset.description: Map of asset name -> per-period returns, all the same length, for a correlation matrix.

pnlPct.description: P&L for the trade as a fraction, e.g. 0.02 = 2%.

trades.description: Recorded trades, for a per-strategy win-rate/expectancy/Kelly-fraction summary.

riskFreeRate.description: Annual risk-free rate used in Sharpe/Sortino. Defaults to 0.

periodsPerYear.description: Periods per year for annualisation. Defaults to 252 (trading days).
